evidence.title: FIDES: A Concordance Protocol for LLM-Generated Trading Strategies

summary: A new concordance framework called FIDES has been introduced to evaluate and align trading strategies produced by large language models with regulatory and risk‑management standards. The protocol seeks to improve transparency, safety, and compliance in AI‑driven algorithmic trading.
title: Researchers unveil FIDES protocol to verify and standardize LLM‑generated trading strategies
